text:
Michael Kopper, an Enron finance executive who reported to CFO Andrew Fastow, ran Chewco Investments, the partnership whose name plays on Chewbacca.

This comes from the public record on Enron, not from reading the mailboxes, so I can't point to specific emails or dates in the store.

- Chewco was set up in late 1997 to buy California pension fund CalPERS's stake in the JEDI partnership (Joint Energy Development Investments), so that Enron could keep JEDI off its consolidated books.
- Kopper managed Chewco while he was an Enron employee. He later moved his interest to William Dodson, his domestic partner, and he pleaded guilty in 2002 to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and money laundering.
- Fastow, who oversaw the structure, was not the named manager of Chewco. His own partnerships were the LJM entities, named after his wife and children rather than a film character.
- A related vehicle, Obi-1 Holdings, also drew on Star Wars (Obi-Wan Kenobi). I'm less sure of its details and wouldn't rely on my memory for who ran it.
